extraction_notes: Generic amine and formamide structures were represented with atom-mapped wildcards for R1 and R2. Reagent structures for boric acid, tris(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)borane, acetic acid, DMF, MeCN, water, and formamide were not all explicitly validated because only drawn structures were required to have validated SMILES; boric acid and tris(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)borane were left with empty SMILES since they were text labels only in the figure. Solvent/source ambiguity preserved as written: Nguyen uses DMF at 150 °C or HCONH2 at 25-150 °C; Sheppard shows B(OCH2CF3)3 over arrow, DMF near arrow, and MeCN, 5 h, 80 °C below; This study shows DMF, 25-85 °C or HCONH2, 45 °C.
